title: Tenma Tsukasa — One Foot In Front Of The Other〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: One Foot In Front Of The Other（2★）
meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis

rows.Line: Phoenix Stage - Green Room

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Does everyone have a drink ready?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, here's to a successful 30th Anniversary Show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Sakurako
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Kamishiro, Otori, you guys did such an amazing job! But I guess this is it for Team Birdie...

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Haha! Team Birdie?!
That's the first time I'm hearing this name.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Each of our practices was a great learning experience. It was an honor to be able to perform on stage with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Likewise! So, let's make the most of this after-party and really have a blast!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna chat lots and lots with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nishie
rows.Line: Nice job out there, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Nishie...!
Um, you too.

rows.Speaker: Nishie
rows.Line:
I really loved your Cowardly Canary!
You just kept getting better and better as time went on too. It gave me a huge boost of motivation.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No, um...!
You did a really amazing job as the witch, Nishie.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, if you don't mind...
Can you tell me how you practice for shows?

rows.Speaker: Nishie
rows.Line:
Of course!
I was actually about to ask you the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: We've succeeded as a team countless times before, but this feeling never gets old.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Anyway, there are some people I'd like to talk to. You should do the same and enjoy yourself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Now, I can talk to Rui and the others whenever, so I should start by congratulating everyone from the Phoenix Stage...)
Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
You did such an amazing job as Rio!
It stung pretty bad when I didn't get the part, but we were all totally blown away by your performance!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Yeah, I felt really conflicted the entire time. A part of me was sad that I didn't get the part, while another part of me was really glad that you were chosen for it.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: But we're not letting you hog all the glory next time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, challenge accepted!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Still, Tenma, you're growing at such an astonishing pace. How did you practice playing your character?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I tried putting myself in Rio's shoes by simulating what his situation was like in real life.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For example, well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rio ran around for three days and nights on nothing but water. I wanted to know what that was like, so I ended up skipping several meals...

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: I see. That explains why you were able to put on such a believable performance...

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: We'll come up with those kinds of ideas from time to time, but to actually go through with them... I guess that's what sets you apart from the rest of us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, I struggled to come up with any other ideas regarding this role...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I probably shouldn't tell them that I actually didn't eat for three days straight.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What else was there...? Oh, Rio chased the phoenix around, so I practiced by chasing after Robo-Phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Robo-Phoenix?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's the robot I made.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wah?! R-Rui...? How long have you been there...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I heard you talking when I was pouring myself a drink.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, would you all like to see it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we have this corner to ourselves, so we shouldn't be too much of a bother.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Alright, allow me to introduce...
Robo-Phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Whoa! It's way bigger than I thought!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: I heard that you can make your own robots and drones, Kamishiro, but this is so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: So, how did you practice with this thing exactly? You can give us a taste since we have this corner to ourselves, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Robo-Phoenix, activate!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Hey, it's flying...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, I had to catch her by doing something like...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This...!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Hey, she dodged you!
I didn't realize she could move so fast!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... This is likely going to be our final game of cat and mouse, so I will catch you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Tsukasa, I programmed her to become more elusive each time I thought you were getting too close.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You never said anything about that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that was deliberate.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, she was set to super grandmaster mode the last time you did this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That name makes it sound impossible to catch her!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But enough talk... Now's my chance!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Close! That was a nice fake!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: You can do it, Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene, look!
Tsukasa's chasing after Robo-Phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You've gotta be kidding me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There! No! Got you...!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Oh, now! No, a little to the right!
Actually, let's try catching her together!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Okay! I'll go this way!
Tenma, you attack her straight on!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Got it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! Robo-Phoenix is trapped and doesn't know what to do!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I have you noooow!!!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Yeah! Nice one, Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, it was a team effort!

rows.Speaker: Nishie
rows.Line: Hehe. Your troupe leader's so full of energy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Full of energy? More like full of hot air...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We've had a chance to really get to know the cast of the Phoenix Stage...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We've become used to practicing and performing at the Phoenix Stage as well. But that ends today.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I really appreciate you all agreeing to do a joint performance with us! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was an incredible experience and we learned so much. I... We even grew quite a bit as actors...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We look forward to working with you again in the future! I hope you'll have us back sometime!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you very much☆
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to performing with you all again and seeing how you've grown.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Likewise!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The road to stardom is a long one.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But I'll make it as long as I don't give up.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll keep moving forward, even if it means just taking baby steps! I will become a true star someday...!)
